title: NASA C-MAPSS / Saxena and colleagues
description: Public simulated run-to-failure engines. Our fleet is a declared abstraction.

title: de Pater and Mitici
description: Prior integrated prognostics, repairable spares and shared maintenance slots. Integration alone is not our contribution.

title: LightGBM / Ke and colleagues
description: Gradient-boosted decision trees used for horizon-specific classifiers.

title: scikit-learn probability calibration
description: Isotonic calibration uses separate engines. Brier loss alone does not isolate calibration quality.

title: Romano, Patterson and Candes
description: CQR was considered and not used: interval coverage does not supply the failure CDF the policy queries.

title: Lufthansa Technik AVIATAR
description: Existing commercial predictive health analytics and maintenance planning. Our benchmark does not replace these services.

title: Airbus Skywise Core
description: Existing aircraft data integration and fleet-performance services. Field comparison remains future work.
